independent_solution: Axes: x up along the plane, y perpendicular. Launch at beta to the plane: u_x = v0 cos(beta), u_y = v0 sin(beta); a_x = -g sin(alpha), a_y = -g cos(alpha).
(b) y = 0 again at T = 2 v0 sin(beta)/(g cos(alpha)).
(a) L = u_x T + (1/2) a_x T^2 = 2 v0^2 sin(beta)[cos(beta) cos(alpha) - sin(beta) sin(alpha)]/(g cos^2(alpha)) = 2 v0^2 sin(beta) cos(alpha + beta)/(g cos^2(alpha)).
(c) 2 sin(beta) cos(alpha + beta) = sin(alpha + 2 beta) - sin(alpha), maximal when alpha + 2 beta = pi/2: beta = pi/4 - alpha/2.
questions.independent_answer: (a) L = 2 v0^2 sin(beta) cos(alpha+beta)/(g cos^2 alpha); (b) T = 2 v0 sin(beta)/(g cos alpha); (c) beta = pi/4 - alpha/2
questions.official_answer: (a) L = 2 v0^2 sin(beta) cos(alpha+beta)/(g cos^2 alpha); (b) T = 2 v0 sin(beta)/(g cos alpha); (c) beta = pi/4 - alpha/2 (printed on pinned answers page 11)

independent_solution: The plane's normal makes angle theta with the vertical. Incoming velocity (vertical, speed v0): v0 cos(theta) into the plane, v0 sin(theta) along the plane downhill.
Elastic rebound reverses the normal part: v0 cos(theta) away from the plane, v0 sin(theta) downhill kept. Gravity: -g cos(theta) normal, +g sin(theta) downhill.
Flight time T = 2 v0 cos(theta)/(g cos(theta)) = 2 v0/g; distance down the plane d = v0 sin(theta) T + (1/2) g sin(theta) T^2 = 2 v0^2 sin(theta)/g + 2 v0^2 sin(theta)/g = 4 v0^2 sin(theta)/g.
questions.independent_answer: 4 v0^2 sin(theta)/g, down the slope from the first impact
questions.official_answer: A v0^2 sin(theta)/g as printed on pinned answers page 11 (the coefficient is printed as the letter 'A')

independent_solution: Trajectory through P(5, 1): 1 = 5 tan(theta) - 25 g/(2 v^2 cos^2 theta).
theta = 45 deg: 1 = 5 - 25 g/v^2 -> v^2 = 25 g/4, v = 5 sqrt(g)/2: (A) true. Apex at x = v^2 sin(2 theta)/(2g) = 25/8 = 3.125 m < 5 m: (B) true.

theta = 30 deg: 25 g/(1.5 v^2) = 5/sqrt3 - 1 = 1.887 -> v^2 = 8.83 g; apex at 8.83 x 0.866/2 = 3.82 m < 5 m, so the apex is before P: (C) false. theta = tan^-1(1/5): 1 = 1 - (positive) is impossible for g > 0: (D) false.
